# Zone -> directory server registration from ASSS 1.4.4 src/core/directory.c
# (compiled unmodified; init_data() builds the packet, SendUpdates() sizes it).
# update <length> <packet bytes>
# Layout (packed, little-endian), 94 fixed bytes then a NUL-terminated description:
#   0x00 u32 ip          always 0; the directory server uses the datagram's source IP
#   0x04 u16 port        the zone's game port
#   0x06 u16 players     player count (whole server, or that virtual server's)
#   0x08 u16 scoresp     ASSS always sends 1 ('keeps scores')
#   0x0A u32 version     ASSS sends 134, not its own version: priit's dirserv requires it
#   0x0E ch[32] name     truncated and NUL-terminated
#   0x2E ch[48] password truncated and NUL-terminated; zero-filled to the end
#   0x5E ch[..] descr    NUL-terminated, up to 386 incl. NUL; the packet stops after it
# Sent to every configured directory server every 60 s (ASSS: SetTimer initial 1000,
# interval 6000 centiseconds), from an ephemeral UDP port, with no reply and no
# acknowledgement. Defaults: Directory:Port 4991, Directory:Password 'cane',
# name '<no name provided>', description '<no description provided>'.
# One packet per listen socket; a virtual server (Listen:ConnectAs) reads its settings
# from a 'Directory-<connectas>' section first and reports only its own population.
